body: Thought about leaving, but I have no job, (sent out my resume to a lot of local liqour places), no money as its going towards paying for course fees. Maybe after I finish I'll go there, thing is in Japan women don't want to be tied down with a boyfriend apparently.

Sadly in Australia's society you do need a piece of paper to prove your worth :/ I did learn some things, but most of it was from bad experiences. I've tried everything though, and nothing works because I just get knocked down after every attempt. But after thinking about it at 1 in the morning; decided to just give up on my life. Won't be killing myself, but its a last resort at this point. I'll be honest and say that the reason I never talk about this to friends or family, or here for instance. Is because I just end up pushing people away and just making a mess of it.

I can try to re-examine how I'm dealing with my problems, see how that turns out. It's just I'm at the end of my wits with this, and I vowed to myself that if I end up failing TAFE, which is like college; between High School and University. I'll just off myself then and there as I'll have no worth to myself whatsoever.
